text:
maria: noticing spike of control-plane 503s in eu-north1 since ~09:12 UTC. apiserver healthz returning 503 intermittently, app traffic erroring. possible link to GPU batch scale-up?
infra-bot: ALERT: control-plane-health degraded eu-north1 — apiserver_503_rate > 15m threshold. triggered at 09:13:02 UTC.
jonah: looking now. any recent infra jobs? autoscaler events?
maria: yes — batch-gpu-autoscale policy kicked at 09:10 to add 24 GPUs for training queue. saw ~200 node attach events over 2m.
alex: paste of quick check:
```
$ curl -sS -I http://apiserver.eunorth.internal/healthz
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2026 09:13:40 GMT
Content-Length: 13
```
jonah: checking masters: master-1/2/3 fd count spiked on master-2. kube-apiserver logs show a bunch of `http2: stream error` and `accept tcp: too many open files` around 09:12:30.
sre-oncall: noticed controlplane-proxy (mesh-proxy) CPU and conn table high on masters, likely proxy holding onto connections from kubelet/egress. conntrack on NAT nodes also shows > 200k TCP_ESTABLISHED.
maria: controller-manager metrics show leader-election latency increasing, reconcile queue backing up for nodes controller. some GPU nodes stuck in NotReady for ~30s during attach flow.
callum: hypothesis: fast attach/attach churn + sidecar/proxy behavior is causing long-lived connection spikes -> fd/conntrack exhaustion on apiserver frontends -> 503s and controller-manager timeouts.
alex: quick mitigation options: 1) pause autoscaler job 2) rotate mesh-proxy on masters 3) increase apiserver listener limits / bump ephemeral port range on NATs. which do we want now?
jonah: pause autoscaler ASAP (maria do you have perms) and open ticket to throttle attach batch size. also let's restart mesh-proxy pods on masters one at a time to avoid complete outage.
maria: paused autoscaler job (jobscheduler) at 09:15 UTC. confirming no new attach flood.
infra-bot: Action taken: autoscaler job "batch-gpu-autoscale" paused by maria at 09:15:11 UTC.
sre-oncall: rolling restart of mesh-proxy on master-1 done, master-2 next. masters back to stable FD counts after restarts. apiserver 503 rate dropped back below threshold at 09:18:40.
callum: followups: add soft-rate-limit to autoscaler, add backpressure when control-plane fd/conntrack usage > 70%, and add a canary mode for large attach batches. also put a contended-attach alert into the control-plane runbook.
jonah: we should also add a circuit-breaker in the mesh-proxy to avoid proxy-level connection pinning during attach storms. file follow-ups in infra backlog.
maria: filing postmortem now, tagging eng-sre, eng-runtime and infra teams. assigning to jonah for short-term throttle change.
alex: small note: consider increasing master ephemeral port range on NATs and tuning conntrack timeout for ESTABLISHED to avoid ephemeral exhaustion during future rapid scale events.
callum: thanks all, reassigning to oncall for writeup. will schedule a postmortem meeting. :thumbsup:
